name: friends
description: Your friends (a one-way list: they are not told): add by username or from suggestions (people you share with), remove. Friends without access show as one-tap picks in the Share sheet. Reached by: app go_to shared, then shared_nav friends.

actions.name: add
actions.description: Type a username in "Add by username" and add it, as the Add button does. The account is not told. Refused (addError) for no such account, yourself, or 500 friends

actions.name: add_suggestion
actions.description: Add a suggestion by its username, in one tap

actions.name: refresh
actions.description: Reload friends and suggestions; also tries again after an error

actions.name: remove
actions.description: Take a friend off the list by username; nothing they were shared changes, and they are not told

username.description: The account's username: what add_suggestion, remove and share_with take

friends.description: Your friends, by name; null until the first load

username.description: The account's username: what add_suggestion, remove and share_with take

suggestions.description: People you shared with or who shared with you, not friends yet; most recent first

busy.description: An add or a removal is in flight

error.description: A load, a suggestion or a removal that failed

addError.description: Why the username typed could not be added, under the field
